name: Anthony "Coin" Rose
biography: Dr. Anthony "Coin" Rose is the Director of Security Research and Chief Operating Officer at BC Security, as well as a professor at the Air Force Institute of Technology, where he serves as an officer in the United States Air Force. His doctorate in Electrical Engineering focused on building cyber defenses using machine learning and graph theory. Anthony specializes in adversary tactic emulation planning, Red and Blue Team operations, and embedded systems security. Anthony has presented at security conferences, including Black Hat, DEF CON, HackMiami, RSA, HackSpaceCon, Texas Cyber Summit, and HackRedCon. He also leads the development of offensive security tools, including Empire and Moriarty.
